name: ASM · Housekeeping
description: Nightly: compress run dirs older than 14 days (never the latest), flag stale runs and locks, update nuclei templates, check pinned images, disk usage. Discord on issues plus Monday summary.

parameters.jsCode:
const STAGE = 'housekeeping';
const MAX_MINUTES = 120;
const BODY = "L=/opt/loot/asm
RETAIN_DAYS=14
IMAGES="projectdiscovery/httpx:v1.12.0 projectdiscovery/alterx:v0.0.6 projectdiscovery/mapcidr:v1.1.16 projectdiscovery/cdncheck:v1.1.36 hahwul/dalfox:v2.12.0"

disk_pct=$(df -P /opt/loot | awk 'NR==2 {gsub("%","",$5); print $5}')
before_mb=$(du -sm "$L" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)

: > compressed.txt
: > skipped_busy.txt
for eng in "$L"/*/; do
  e=$(basename "$eng")
  case "$e" in _cache) continue;; esac
  latest=$(ls -d "$eng"2*T*Z-*/ 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -1)
  for d in "$eng"2*T*Z-*/; do
    [ -d "$d" ] || continue
    [ "$d" = "$latest" ] && continue
    [ -n "$(find "$d" -maxdepth 0 -mtime +"$RETAIN_DAYS" 2>/dev/null)" ] || continue
    busy=0
    for j in "$d"*/job.sh; do
      [ -f "$j" ] || continue
      [ -f "$(dirname "$j")/.done" ] || busy=1
    done
    if [ "$busy" = 1 ]; then echo "$d" >> skipped_busy.txt; continue; fi
    name=$(basename "$d")
    if tar -czf "$eng$name.tar.gz" -C "$eng" "$name" 2>>tar.log && rm -rf "$d"; then
      echo "$e/$name" >> compressed.txt
    fi
  done
done

after_mb=$(du -sm "$L" 2>/dev/null | cut -f1)
find "$L" -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name .lock -type d -mmin +960 2>/dev/null | sed "s#^$L/##" > stale_locks.txt

tpl_before=$(nuclei -templates-version 2>&1 | grep -oE 'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | tail -1)
timeout 10m nuclei -update-templates -silent > nuclei_update.log 2>&1
tpl_rc=$?
tpl_after=$(nuclei -templates-version 2>&1 | grep -oE 'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' | tail -1)

: > missing_images.txt
for img in $IMAGES; do
  docker image inspect "$img" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "$img" >> missing_images.txt
done

jq -n \
  --argjson disk "${disk_pct:-0}" --argjson before "${before_mb:-0}" --argjson after "${after_mb:-0}" \
  --arg tb "$tpl_before" --arg ta "$tpl_after" --argjson trc "$tpl_rc" \
  --rawfile comp compressed.txt --rawfile busy skipped_busy.txt --rawfile locks stale_locks.txt --rawfile imgs missing_images.txt \
  '{disk_pct: $disk, loot_mb_before: $before, loot_mb_after: $after,
    compressed: ($comp | split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))),
    skipped_busy: ($busy | split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))),
    stale_locks: ($locks | split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))),
    missing_images: ($imgs | split("\n") | map(select(length > 0))),
    templates_before: $tb, templates_after: $ta, templates_rc: $trc}' > result.json
";
const EXTRA = [];
const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[-:]/g, '').replace(/\.\d+Z$/, 'Z');
const rand = Math.floor(Math.random() * 0x10000).toString(16).padStart(4, '0');
const job_dir = `/opt/loot/asm/_sys/${stamp}-${rand}/${STAGE}`;
const header = [
  '#!/usr/bin/env bash',
  'set -uo pipefail',
  `S='${job_dir}'`,
  ...EXTRA,
  'mkdir -p "$S" && cd "$S" || exit 1',
  ''
].join('
');
return [{ json: { job_dir, script: header + BODY, max_minutes: MAX_MINUTES } }];
